description.p: OFM (Orthodox File Manager) is a two-panel file manager for GNOME in the tradition of Norton Commander, Far Manager, Midnight Commander and Total Commander.

ul.li: Two panels with tabs, selection by mask and quick search
Command line and embedded terminal that follow the active panel
Copy, move and delete as background jobs, with Trash support
Built-in viewer for text and hex, with several encodings
Find files, panelize results, read-only archive browsing
User menu, rebindable keys and themes
